The '''CC-V 'Legion' Cryo Projector''' was a weapon that used a liquid cryo substance to cause severe freeze damage in targets. It was especially effective against heavily armored infantry units.

The weapon was developed by the [[Ulban Arms/Legends|Ulban Corporation]] with the help of some of the most renowned [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
The CC-V 'Legion' Cryo Projector is a weapon in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Schematics for this weapon can be looted in the [[:w:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|Lost Star Destroyer]] and [[:w:c:swg:IG-88|IG-88]] Heroic Encounters and can be manufactured by players of the [[:w:c:swg:Trader (Munitions)|munitions trader]] profession.
